M5 MacBook Pro or wait for the M6 touchscreen? I've been stuck on this for months. 👀 Here's my situation. I'm still on a 2019 MacBook Pro and it's become a bottleneck for video editing — big projects bog it down, exports drag, and the render wait is the reason I've been putting off entire edits. The upgrade math is the problem. A base M6 MacBook Pro could land before the end of the year, but it's the same design I already have. The redesign I actually want — OLED, touchscreen, slimmer, no notch — isn't expected until late 2026, more likely 2027. And my 2019 was the last MacBook Pro with a Touch Bar, which I miss more than I thought I would. I've also been burned waiting before. Held out months for a Steam Machine, it shipped late, and I'd lost interest by the time it arrived. Tech release timelines lie. So if you edit video for a living: upgrade now or hold out for the redesign? 👇 #macbookpro #macbookm5 #macbookforvideoediting #videoediting #techtok
